summary: Backend-only regression + new feature testing for Forge Fitness. Executed full pytest suite (48/48 passed): 32 pre-existing regression tests plus 16 new tests covering food DB availability, admin content management CRUD, and barcode lookup. All bug-fix and feature specs verified live: empty q browse returns built-in DB (40 items, spec >=30), 'milk' search returns 15 results including 12 Open Food Facts enrichments (source=off), 'chicken' returns non-zero calorie items, /api/admin/foods lists 84 seeded foods, /api/admin/exercises lists 43, /api/admin/achievements lists 12. Admin CRUD (create/update/delete for exercises, create/delete for foods, upsert/delete for achievements by code) all working with proper 401 (no token) and 403 (normal user) authorization. Barcode 737628064502 returns 200. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1162 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, foods, admin, sessions, photos) for maintainability.

Admin POST/PUT endpoints accept raw dict bodies without Pydantic validation (e.g. /admin/exercises, /admin/foods, /admin/achievements). Adding schemas would enforce required fields (name/calories) and reject malformed input with 422 instead of silently inserting docs with None values.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_-prefixed exercises, foods, achievements per test — all cleaned up in-test via DELETE endpoints. Used a fresh uuid-based demo user via /auth/register for user-level tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/ (test_forge_backend.py + test_admin_content_and_foods.py). Run non-parallel: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q -o addopts='' . BASE URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Admin creds admin@forge.app / Admin123!. Demo users are created per-session with TEST_user_{hex}@forge.app / TestPass123!. OFF external calls (search.openfoodfacts.org and world.openfoodfacts.org v2) worked reliably in this run but are best-effort — tests tolerate absence.
